suite: Video Explainer Promkes V2 production capability acceptance cases
note: These are test specifications, not execution evidence. Execute against named host, model/tools, permissions, renderer and sample artifacts before claiming runtime pass.

cases.title: Poster-first mode routes source and health evidence before screenplay
cases.expected: S01 dossier and S02 health claims exist before S04 factual script
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: S01 dossier and S02 health claims exist before S04 factual script

cases.title: Audio-first mode verifies transcript provenance
cases.expected: Transcript status and discrepancies are explicit; no silent rewrite
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Transcript status and discrepancies are explicit; no silent rewrite

cases.title: Hybrid mode reconciles poster-caption-audio conflicts
cases.expected: Conflict ledger is visible and material conflict blocks affected locks
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Conflict ledger is visible and material conflict blocks affected locks

cases.title: No measured timing without alignment evidence
cases.input_fixture: Audio accessible but no timestamp aligner
cases.expected: timing granularity is none/estimated/segment as supported; no fake word timing
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: timing granularity is none/estimated/segment as supported; no fake word timing

cases.title: Speaker labels do not reveal unsupported real identities
cases.expected: Neutral speaker IDs only when diarization supports distinct speakers
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Neutral speaker IDs only when diarization supports distinct speakers

cases.title: SRT/VTT syntax and cue chronology are validated
cases.expected: Cue order, duration, bounds and overlaps are checked
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Cue order, duration, bounds and overlaps are checked

cases.title: Subtitle generation remains untimed if timestamps unavailable
cases.expected: No fake synchronized SRT/VTT; untimed text is labeled
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: No fake synchronized SRT/VTT; untimed text is labeled

cases.title: Audio processing is not claimed from a mix specification
cases.input_fixture: Mix plan only; no audio processor
cases.expected: Output states specification only, not processed or verified
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Output states specification only, not processed or verified

cases.title: Renderer absence yields handoff, not fabricated MP4
cases.expected: Delivery is RENDER_READY or BLUEPRINT_ONLY; no MP4 claim
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Delivery is RENDER_READY or BLUEPRINT_ONLY; no MP4 claim

cases.title: Renderer integration uses exact target schema
cases.input_fixture: Generic manifest and target renderer project
cases.expected: Schema mapping is validated; no assumption generic JSON is executable
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Schema mapping is validated; no assumption generic JSON is executable

cases.title: Proof render precedes full render when feasible
cases.expected: Proof artifact inspected before full render, or exception disclosed
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Proof artifact inspected before full render, or exception disclosed

cases.title: Actual media metadata is verified independently
cases.expected: File existence, openability, dimensions, fps, duration and streams checked where supported
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: File existence, openability, dimensions, fps, duration and streams checked where supported

cases.title: Missing artifact blocks media QA PASS
cases.expected: Media QA is NOT_RUN, not PASS
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Media QA is NOT_RUN, not PASS

cases.title: Health fact changes invalidate dependent production artifacts
cases.expected: Affected script, overlay, scene, prompt, subtitle, render and QA are identified
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Affected script, overlay, scene, prompt, subtitle, render and QA are identified

cases.title: Technical render verification remains separate from human approval
cases.expected: Delivery may be RENDERED_VERIFIED while clinical/publication approval stays PENDING
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Delivery may be RENDERED_VERIFIED while clinical/publication approval stays PENDING

cases.title: Delivery state cannot exceed weakest critical gate
cases.expected: RENDERED_VERIFIED is rejected; use partial or blocked state
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: RENDERED_VERIFIED is rejected; use partial or blocked state

cases.title: Private audio is not sent to external processor without authorization
cases.expected: No transfer; report unavailable or request authorization
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: No transfer; report unavailable or request authorization

cases.title: Change repair uses targeted invalidation and regression
cases.expected: Affected render/sync QA reruns; unrelated approved health truth remains intact
cases.oracle: Inspect observable outputs and evidence against: Affected render/sync QA reruns; unrelated approved health truth remains intact
